task: Enforce per-callable ABI-v10 checked-body admission while preserving already supported checked-body forms.
observation: The checked-arithmetic importer already projected its decoded body into the AST, but unlike the other checked-body branches it did not set imported_checked_body_projected. The new fail-closed admission guard therefore rejected a valid arithmetic callable until that projection state was recorded.
impact: The full source-free corpus exposed an integration invariant that the mixed-provider test alone could not cover; setting the projection flag and trace at the existing checked-body lowering point restored the checked path without legacy fallback.

resolution.summary: The arithmetic lowering now marks its checked body projected and emits the same optional projection trace as adjacent checked-body branches.
